appKey.description: Dynamic: the Smart Form's short key, the {appKey} of /sf/{appKey}/...

path.description: Dynamic: the pathname under /sf/{appKey}: empty or starting with / (both address the root)

schema.description: CDU protocol versions this runtime supports. When present, reject an incompatible page before invoking its initialization process. Omit only for legacy clients.

Opt-in to versioned renders: the 'version' of the render the client already shows. Present (an empty string on the first render) → the result carries 'version'; equal to the version of this render → the result is only {notModified: true, version, refresh} and the client keeps what it shows. The page is still rendered in full (a Corezoid /get still runs); only the payload and the client re-render are saved. Absent → the result is exactly as without this parameter.
